entities.summary: The Sfatul Țării (Country Council) voted for union with Romania (March 27, 1918). Romanian administration brought land reform but also cultural tensions. The Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact's secret protocol (1939) assigned Bessarabia to the Soviet sphere.
